name: companion
description: A disciplined AI pair-programming companion: one steering document (STEERING.md — how Claude queues work, decides with brutal-honest recommendations against a requirements ledger, and keeps the code clean), printed on demand by /companion:resume, plus a portable core — its own task-queue CLI (`tq`; the companion owns the queue and deliberately does not use Claude Code's native tasks), also reachable via the companion-tq MCP server for any MCP-capable client; an advisory credential-shape scanner; cross-session resume; and an animated status line. It runs one loop — propose → queue → drain. Everything is advisory (R100) — nothing blocks a write or forces a session to keep going anymore, traded deliberately for portability beyond Claude Code. Replaces the earlier four-plugin system: ~15 hooks of advisory prose collapsed into one readable file, then its own enforced core retired in favor of an MCP server + skills.
